newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip after range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip after range-bound trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended weaker across the board on Monday after trading in a narrow range, as the market looked for clear direction, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 0.9 yen per kilogram lower, with the benchmark May contract ending down by 0.9 yen at 141.6 yen.

After the market started the day on a mixed tone, prices drifted sideways for most of the day. "Market players were divided over near-term direction, but basically the market lacked fresh incentives to push up prices," one trader said.
